end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting ordered pairs using horizontal-then-vertical movement.
Identified quadrants from coordinate signs, including axis points with a zero coordinate.
Practised reflecting points across an axis by changing the relevant sign.
Harsh initially said (3, 2) and (2, 3) were the same point; this was corrected later by focusing on coordinate order.
Teach-back was not passed before the lesson ended.
end.parentNote: Asha practised plotting points by moving along x first and then y, identifying quadrants from signs, and reflecting points across an axis. Harsh correctly used negative x for left, positive y for up, and recognised that points with a zero coordinate lie on an axis rather than in a quadrant. There was a mix-up between (3, 2) and (2, 3), and it was corrected later by revisiting the ordered order of the coordinates. At home, ask Harsh to draw a small coordinate grid and plot several pairs, saying “x first, y second” each time.
